description: Management's own weekly, per-block planning number — distinct from the flowering-model forecast (productiongrid) and from a Coffee Forecast Override (what a person on the ground thinks a block will give). This is what management now expects, used to work out the crew a week needs.

fields.label: Week Starting (Monday)
fields.description: Snapped to the Monday of the week entered.

fields.label: Revised Forecast (kg cherry)
fields.description: Management's own planning number for this block this week. Wholly manual — nothing computes it for you.

fields.label: Actual (kg cherry)
fields.description: Weighbridge kilograms received for this block in this week. Pulled from Harvest Pickup, not typed — refreshed every time this row is saved.

fields.label: Kg per Worker (this week)
fields.description: Blank uses the farm default set on Coffee Production Settings.

fields.label: Workers Needed (computed)
fields.description: Revised forecast ÷ the kg-per-worker rate in effect. Kept so an override below can be judged against it.

fields.label: Workers Needed (override)
fields.description: Blank uses the computed figure. Set this only where a planner knows better — a gappy block, a training day, a known absentee run.

name: Coffee Production Forecast
